newsitem.title: USA: Alpha Microsystems ends talks to sell unit.
newsitem.headline: Alpha Microsystems ends talks to sell unit.

text.p: Alpha Microsystems said on Friday it had ended negotiations with Datacon Management Inc on the sale of Alpha's Alpha HealthCare subsidiary.
Alpha cited lack of agreement on the terms of a definitive agreement.
Alpha announced the signing of a letter of intent to sell the unit to Datacon on August 27.

Alpha said it had decided to eliminate research and development and marketing expenses on certain software and reduce overall operating expenses at Alpha HealthCare before Datacon approached it with an offer to buy the unit.
It said it planned to proceed with these strategies.

Staffing at Alpha HealthCare has been reduced by 50 percent, and the parent company expects the large R&D and marketing-connected losses incurred by the unit over the past two years to diminish "significantly."
